Specification: This module defines a minimal placeholder for rendering or representing a directed graph in GraphViz-style form. The only top-level operator is DotDiGraph, which takes a graph and two operator arguments VL and EL, and returns TRUE unconditionally. The specification contains no state variables, no actions, no temporal behavior, and no verified safety or liveness properties; it is simply a trivial value-level definition.
